paragraphs: Levi HaSarad. Rashi, Yoma (85a), explains: 'It has not been explained to me what this means.' Arukh, entry sarad, explains in the Gaon's name: he made garments of serad, or implements of serad [terms retained pending lexical review]. Ṣ.D. [צ״ד; provisionally Tzemaḥ David] explains: an eminent scholar and sage (Ma'arikh). R. Yishmael, R. Elazar ben Azaryah and R. Akiva walked along the road, and Levi HaSarad and R. Yishmael son of R. Elazar ben Azaryah walked behind them, Yoma there, and Mekhilta, beginning of Tissa.
